The Riemann zeta function is discussed in Appendix A.  In this transport
section, $\zeta$ is instead a positive dimensionless coupling; parentheses
therefore denote multiplication by the enclosed factor.
\begin{equation}
  \zeta(x+1)=\zeta(x)+\zeta(1)
\end{equation}
